language_task: Pick up the ball and place it in the bowl.
outcome_evidence: At frame 0, camera_high shows the orange ball beside the blue bowl. Frames 130-190 in camera_wrist_right show the ball retained between the gripper fingers while camera_high and camera_wrist_left show its lift and transfer toward the bowl. Frames 251-278 in camera_wrist_right show release into the bowl and separation of the fingers from the ball. By frame 310 the gripper has withdrawn, leaving the ball inside the bowl; camera_high confirms this state persists through frame 749. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visibly established.
